input_messages.content: Hello, I’m having some trouble with my mobile data. It either stops working or is very slow, and I really need it to be excellent. I’m currently in France and don’t have access to Wi-Fi. Can you help me get my internet speed back to excellent, please?
Sure, my name is John Smith and my phone number is 555-123-2002. Let me know if you need anything else for verification.
I’m using the phone number 555-123-2002 here in France. That’s the one I need help with.
Yes, please, but I get a bit confused with technical stuff, so could you explain things step by step and as simply as possible? I really want to make sure my internet speed is excellent.

At the top of my phone, I see a signal strength icon with just one bar, and it says "2G." There’s also a little icon that looks like a phone with some lines (I think that’s for data), and my battery is at 80%. I don’t see an airplane icon.

Is that okay, or is something wrong with it?

Okay, I’m ready, but I get nervous about changing settings. Will this mess up anything else on my phone, like my photos or messages? I really don’t want to lose anything important. Could you please reassure me before we start?

What should I do next? Will this make my internet excellent now?
I see a little icon at the top that looks like a phone with some lines, and you mentioned earlier that means data is enabled. So I think my mobile data is turned on. Is that what you needed to know?
Oh, I tried to do a speed test, but it says there’s no connection. That’s strange, since it shows 5G and full bars at the top. What should I do now?
I don’t see an airplane icon at the top of my phone, so I think Airplane Mode is off. Should we check the next thing on your list?
I checked, and it says my SIM card is active and working. What should I do next?
I checked, and Data Saver mode is off on my phone. So I guess that’s not the problem either. What should I try now?

It looks like I do have a VPN connected—there’s a little lock icon at the top, and when I checked, it says VPN is on and connected. Could this be causing my internet problem? What should I do about it?
I went ahead and disconnected the VPN. The lock icon is gone now, and I still see full bars and 5G at the top. Should I try the speed test again to see if my internet is excellent now?

I tried the speed test again, but it still says there’s no connection. I’m getting a bit frustrated—everything looks like it should work, but I still can’t get online. What else can we try? I really need excellent internet speed.

I checked my APN settings, and it says the APN name is "internet" and there’s something about an MMSC URL for picture messages. I’m not sure what any of that means—should I reset these settings, or are they okay as they are?

I’ve reset the APN settings as you suggested. You mentioned I need to reboot my phone now—will restarting it mess up anything, like my photos or messages? I get really anxious about losing things. Can you reassure me before I do this?

I restarted my phone like you said, but when I tried the speed test again, it still says there’s no connection. I’m really starting to worry—why isn’t this working? I just want excellent internet speed. What else can we try?

user_scenario.persona:
At 64 years old, you're a retired librarian who keeps your phone use simple - mainly for calls, texts, and capturing photos of your grandchildren. Technology in general makes you feel uneasy and overwhelmed.

Your technical knowledge is quite limited. Step-by-step instructions often confuse you, and technical terms like "VPN" or "APN" might as well be a foreign language. You only share information when specifically asked.

When dealing with technology, you tend to get flustered quickly. You need constant reassurance and often interrupt with anxious questions. Simple requests like "reboot the phone" can trigger worries about losing precious photos.
